title: Schrodinger Hat

title: Argus
description: Open-source AI security review agent written in Go. It runs real scanners (Semgrep, Gitleaks, OSV-Scanner), reads their findings, and reasons about them like an analyst would.

title: tsundoku
description: A single-owner library of what I have read, what I thought of it and what comes next, readable by Claude and ChatGPT over MCP. It also feeds the Shelf on this site.

title: kanpai
description: The same idea for wine and spirits: what I tasted, what is in the house and what is worth trying, for a sommelier that reads it over MCP.

title: Worky
description: A tool for running interactive workshops. Designed for speakers and educators who want to engage their audience.
